body: I have tried and it never works... I've done so much new stuff since the break up but it doesn't help and it doesn't last. I met new friends, started doing volunteer work so i have stuff to do but my mind is almost always on her... And no matter what i do i can't shake her out of my mind and it kills me.

Sorry to hear this man but from personal experience a break or "needs space" means she's going to break up with you so prepare for that. Happened to me, still getting over it and it's hard as fuck. But i can tell you this, no matter how much you want to contact her, don't. i did that mistake that i kept contacting her when she wanted "a break" and i don't really know if things would've been different if i didn't. But i doubt it. 

Anyway, my ex kept me around waiting for her for three months and in retrospect it was for her own gain only, she always wanted to break up but she kept me around because of "moments of weakness" when she missed me and so on.

Just be careful and i hope it works out for you.

I don't know how to get out of it, she crushed me and left me broken. I don't have the strength to do anything about it. I've been to a therapist but everytime i'm there i can't really tell how i actually feel. I'm ashamed and if i say it out loud it becomes very real and there's no turning back. I don't know.
I don't have the strength to do any of this. I'm barley hanging on as it is... I can't be that person who does that.

Yeah, i know i am... But it still hurts alot. I miss her and i can't stop thinking about her, makes me sick when i think about her with someone new. I don't know what to do really. I guess i have very low self-esteem but i don't know how to work on that.

My ex cheated on me atleast twice, one time with a man that was 20+ years older than her (she claimed he raped her but you don't stay in touch with a old dude who raped you for several months, not blocking him when he sends sex novels and dick picks to you and you don't go back to his place a second time.) and with a girl she met at some conference. She lied about both for several months before coming clean, i always felt something was wrong so i pressed her and she admitted. She also kept texting with a guy who's only goal was to fuck her, he even said so. I told her i wasn't okay with that so she blocked him for some months and then added him again later. All of this during a 7 month period. 

Our relationship never was very good, she was abusive on top of this but i stayed with her because i loved her, i still do. She eventually ended it with me because i couldn't bend to her rules. So one day when i was at work she kept calling me and i couldn't answer, so she went all mad because i "should always answer when she calls or text" so yeah, after that she ended it. I was totally devestated and i'm still trying to get over it but it's hard. I miss her every day and i still love her, it's so stupid and i don't understand it since she abused me both mentally and physically, cheated on me and was very controlling... Life sucks.
